rules.rationale: Constructor equation defining isNumericVal to be true on Int values; it names the proof-domain predicate and does not execute the program or assert a separate reusable fact.
Constructor equation defining isNumericVal to be true on Bool values; it is one case of the named domain predicate rather than an operational rule or additional lemma.
Constructor equation defining isNumericVal to be true on Float values; it contributes directly to the predicate definition and replaces no fixed-semantics execution.
The owise equation completes the total definition of isNumericVal by returning false for every remaining Val constructor; it is definitional case coverage, not a trusted mathematical fact.
Base equation for the structural definition of allNumeric, defining the empty ValSeq as satisfying the predicate.
Recursive constructor equation defining allNumeric on a nonempty ValSeq from the head predicate and the recursively defined tail predicate.
Base equation for the incrAcc summary, defining that no remaining elements leave the accumulator unchanged.

Structural recurrence defining incrAcc for one remaining element by appending the fixed applyBin result and recursing on the tail; the loop claim proves its connection to execution, while this rule only defines the summary term.
